text: Voss had found irregularities in the grant accounts administered by Mara Quill and intended to put them before the board on Monday.

mara.cover: Elias and I had no disagreement about the accounts. The annual audit was routine.
mara.say: Elias told me on Saturday afternoon that he had found a problem in the grant accounts and would take it to the board on Monday.

gideon.say: Voss told me there was a hole in the grant accounts and that it led to his own deputy. He meant to bring it to the board on Monday.

points.note: Voss was about to expose her handling of the grant accounts.

text: Mara Quill was not in the archive room the whole time: she was in the dome with Voss at roughly 22:45 to 22:52.

mara.cover: I was in the archive room cataloguing plates from half past ten until the alarm was raised. I never went near the dome.
mara.say: I went up to the dome. I let myself in at about a quarter to eleven. I only wanted him to give me more time.

points.note: Places her in the dome with the victim inside the time-of-death window.

text: Mara wore a burgundy wool shawl at the gala; its fringe was torn in a struggle and she pushed it into the archive-room bin afterwards.

mara.cover: I took the shawl off because the hall was warm. I have no idea where it ended up.
mara.say: He caught hold of my shawl and the fringe tore. Afterwards I pushed it into the bin in the archive room.

points.note: Her torn shawl links her physically to the struggle.

text: Theo Lark did not leave at 22:15. He stayed in the control room until about 23:05.

theo.cover: I left around quarter past ten and cycled home. I wasn't there when it happened.
theo.say: I didn't leave at quarter past ten. I was in the control room until just after eleven.

points.note: He lied about leaving: he was still in the building at the time of death.

text: From 22:24 to 23:02 Theo sat at the control-room console copying the observatory's unpublished survey data to a USB drive. He never left the console.

theo.cover: I was just finishing some data reductions.
theo.say: I was copying the survey data. All of it, onto a USB stick, because he was cutting me off and it's three years of my life. I sat at that console starting batches by hand from about 22:24 until gone eleven. I never left the chair.

points.note: By his own account he was occupied at the console throughout.

text: At about 22:55 Ivo Brandt saw Mara Quill coming down the service stairs from the dome, flushed and without her shawl.

ivo.cover: I was packing crates by then. I wasn't watching the stairs.
ivo.say: I was on the service stairs — never mind why — and at about five to eleven Dr. Quill came down from the dome. Flushed, in a hurry, and she'd lost that red shawl she had on earlier.

points.note: Eyewitness puts her leaving the dome minutes after the fall.

text: At about 22:35 Ivo saw Gideon Ashby striding toward the dome corridor, visibly furious.

ivo.say: About 22:35 I saw Mr. Ashby marching toward the dome corridor with a face like thunder.

points.note: Seen heading for the dome, angry, shortly before the death.

text: Ashby found the dome corridor door locked, turned back, and left the building at 22:41.

gideon.cover: I left straight after the speeches. I had an early flight.
gideon.say: I went to have it out with him. The corridor door was locked. I stood there like a fool for a minute, then I walked out to my car and left. That was about twenty to eleven.

points.note: By his account he never got into the dome and left before the fall.

text: Ashby sent Voss a threatening text that evening because Voss meant to disclose that Ashby's donation was structured as a tax shelter.

gideon.cover: Elias and I were on excellent terms. I have funded that place for a decade.
gideon.say: Yes, I sent that message. He was going to tell the world my donation was a tax arrangement. I was angry. I threatened his reputation, not his neck.

points.note: He threatened Voss the same evening over a financial exposure.

text: That afternoon Voss told Theo he was cutting his thesis funding. They argued in front of the guests at about 21:10.

theo.cover: It was an ordinary academic disagreement.
theo.say: He told me that afternoon he was pulling my funding. I shouted at him by the bar. Everyone saw.

nell.say: The student, Theo, had a proper row with Dr. Voss by the bar a bit after nine. Something about his money being stopped.

ivo.say: The young one, Theo, was shouting at Dr. Voss by my bar around ten past nine. Funding, I gathered.

points.note: Voss had just ended his funding; they quarrelled publicly.

text: At about 22:45 Nell Okafor heard raised voices from the dome: Voss's, and a woman's.

nell.say: About quarter to eleven I heard raised voices from the dome. Dr. Voss, and a woman. I took it for a staff matter and left them to it.

points.note: A woman was arguing with Voss in the dome at the critical time.

text: Nell spent much of the evening watching a football match on her phone and wrote up her logbook afterwards from memory.

nell.cover: I logged everything as it happened. That book is accurate to the minute.
nell.say: All right. The match was on. I wrote the book up afterwards, from memory. The times are near enough, but I wasn't looking at the clock.

text: Mara disabled the dome corridor camera from her own workstation at 20:58.

mara.cover: Half the staff know my workstation password — it is on a note under the keyboard. Anyone could have done that.
mara.say: I switched the corridor camera to maintenance myself. I wanted to speak to him without being recorded.

points.note: The camera covering the dome was switched off from her login two hours before the death.

text: Only two override keycards exist for the dome service door: Voss's and the deputy director's.

nell.say: There are only two override cards for that service door. The Director had one. The Deputy Director has the other.

mara.cover: I would have to check who holds override cards.
mara.say: There are two override cards. Elias had one and I have the other.

points.note: She held one of only two cards able to open the dome service door at 22:47.

text: Mara's workstation password was written on a note under her keyboard and was known to several staff, Theo among them.

theo.say: Everyone knows Dr. Quill's password — it's on a sticky note under her keyboard. I've used it myself to book telescope time.

mara.say: My password is on a note under my keyboard. Half the staff have used it.

points.note: Others could have used her login to disable the camera.
